name: Philanderous Compact
body:
Source Taldor, Echoes of Glory pg. 27
Aura faint illusion; CL 1st
Slot none; Price 1,500 gp; Weight —
Description
This small, polished leather case opens to reveal a mirror, face powder, rouge, and a puff. Using the puff and uttering a command word allows you to change your appearance once per day as per disguise self. Additionally, you get a +2 competence bonus to Gather Information checks.
Construction
Requirements Craft Wondrous Item, disguise self, creator must have at least 5 ranks in Gather Information; Cost 750 gp, 60 XP
